bio: Tajush Shariah Mufti Muhammad Akhtar Raza Khan Azhari Qadri was one of the great scholars and poets of the Raza family of Bareilly Sharif. He received spiritual authorization (Khilafat) from Mufti-e-Azam Hind, his maternal grandfather, who also appointed him as his Ja Nasheen (spiritual successor), and from Hujjat-ul-Islam Maulana Hamid Raza Khan, his paternal grandfather.
For more than five decades he served the Ummah through teaching and fatwa work, heading the Dar-ul-Ifta at Bareilly Sharif and answering questions from across the world.

Like his forefathers, he expressed his love for the Beloved Prophet in poetry. His Hamd, Naat and Manqabat — especially in praise of Ghaus-e-Azam — are collected in his book Safeena-e-Bakhshish. He wrote his first kalaam at the age of nineteen.
